working_definition_ja: 競走を行う施設全体。
notes: P0-SRC-016. BHA directory treats racecourses as venue entities with location, fixture and course attributes. Facility-level sense only; relation layer preserves differences from Racetrack/Track.

working_definition_ja: 主に北米で競馬場または競走路を指す語。
notes: P0-SRC-017;REL-SRC-007;USCA-SRC-009. North American authority usage supports both venue and physical-surface senses; keep polysemy and scoped relations rather than global equivalence.

working_definition_ja: 競走路そのもの、または競馬場全体を略して指す語。
notes: P0-SRC-017;REL-SRC-007;USCA-SRC-009. USTA uses Track for venue/listing entities while rules also use physical-track senses; preserve polysemy.

working_definition_ja: 競走に使用する走路・経路。
notes: P0-SRC-018. JRA course pages define course geometry, lap distance, straight and start locations; generic definition remains jurisdiction-neutral.

working_definition_ja: 競馬場の主要な走路。
notes: P1-SRC-007;P1-SRC-008. Current Racing Australia programme pages explicitly label the primary racing surface as Main Track; exact facility naming varies by jurisdiction.

working_definition_ja: 同一競馬場の内側にある周回コース。
notes: P1-SRC-004;P1-SRC-005. JRA current course data explicitly distinguishes 内回り from 外回り layouts; English working label is not asserted as JRA's official English term.

working_definition_ja: 同一競馬場の外側にある周回コース。
notes: P1-SRC-004;P1-SRC-005. JRA current course data explicitly distinguishes 外回り from 内回り layouts; exact geometry varies by venue.

working_definition_ja: 周回せず直線主体で競走するコース。
notes: P1-SRC-005. JRA Niigata current course page explicitly identifies its turf 1000m 直線コース; generic Concept does not imply all straight courses share that configuration.

working_definition_ja: 周回形状を持つ競走コース。
楕円形・周回型の競走路を示す表現。
周回コースへ接続する直線状の延長走路。形状・接続位置・使用距離は競馬場ごとに異なる。
notes: TR-SRC-001. JRA overseas-racing facility terminology directly lists chute as シュート／ポケット; the Concept keeps venue-specific geometry rather than imposing one layout globally.

preferred_ja: 最後の直線／ホームストレッチ
working_definition_ja: ゴールへ向かう主要な直線区間。
notes: P0-SRC-018;P0-SRC-019. JRA course/facility material identifies the final straight and its geometry; regional labels remain separate.

working_definition_ja: スタンド側に位置する直線区間を指す表現。多くの競馬場ではゴールを含む直線だが、具体的配置は競馬場ごとに異なる。
notes: VE-SRC-007. JRA's current facility glossary explicitly uses ホームストレッチ for the stand-side straight while describing course geometry; this verifies the racing sense without treating the label as globally preferred.

preferred_ja: 向正面／バックストレッチ
working_definition_ja: スタンド側直線の反対側、競馬場の奥側に位置する直線区間。
notes: VE-SRC-003;VE-SRC-007. The Jockey Club directly defines Backstretch/Back Straight as the far-side straight from the stands, and JRA independently uses バックストレッチ for the opposite straight.

working_definition_ja: コースの曲線区間。
notes: P0-SRC-019. JRA facility glossary defines コーナー as curved portions of the course and explains first through fourth corner numbering.

working_definition_ja: 主に英国系等でコースの曲線区間を指す語。
notes: TR-SRC-001. JRA overseas-racing facility terminology directly maps bend to コーナー and relates it to turn; regional preferred usage remains distinct from the generic Turn Concept.

working_definition_ja: 曲線区間を指す一般表現。
走路の境界を示す柵。
notes: P0-SRC-020. JRA defines 埒 as course/racecourse fencing and distinguishes inner and outer rails.

working_definition_ja: 競走中に馬がその間を走る走路境界のレール。配置・移動・安全基準は競馬場・管轄で異なる。
notes: TR-SRC-004. Current BHA racecourse instructions define Running Rails as the rails between which horses are intended to race and prescribe placement/safety requirements; exact rail systems remain jurisdiction-specific.

working_definition_ja: 内柵を通常位置から移動した設定・位置。
notes: P0-SRC-021. Racing Australia current meeting data publishes Rail Position as an operational course setting; exact formats vary by authority.

working_definition_ja: ゴール位置を示す標識・柱。設置位置や決勝線との合わせ方は競馬場規則による。
notes: TR-SRC-004. Current BHA racecourse instructions prescribe winning-post siting, alignment and visibility/safety, directly supporting the British racecourse-infrastructure sense.

working_definition_ja: 着順判定の基準となるゴール線。
notes: P0-SRC-019. JRA goal-board explanation identifies the aligned finish line used for finish/photo-finish judgment.

working_definition_ja: 各距離のレースが開始される位置。
notes: P0-SRC-018. JRA course pages publish starting positions for individual race distances.

working_definition_ja: 馬を区画に入れて一斉発走させる装置。
notes: P0-SRC-019. JRA facility glossary defines the starting-gate apparatus and stall assignment used for flat-race starts.

working_definition_ja: 主に英国系で発馬機を指す語。
notes: P0-SRC-015. BHA current non-runner/start rules explicitly use starting stalls as the Flat starting apparatus.

preferred_ja: モバイルバリア／移動式発走ゲート
working_definition_ja: 繋駕競走のmobile startで、走行する車両と展開したbarrier arms等を用いて馬群を整列させる発走装置。
notes: VE-SRC-008;VE-SRC-009. Australian harness rules use Mobile Barrier as the moving starting apparatus, while HRNZ regulations describe the vehicle and extended arms; construction and start procedure remain authority-specific.

working_definition_ja: 競走前に馬を周回・待機させ観客等が確認する場所。
notes: P0-SRC-019. JRA facility glossary defines paddock as the pre-race area where runners walk and are inspected/observed.

working_definition_ja: 主に英国等で、競走前に出走馬を周回・展示し、騎手が合流して発走へ向かう区域。
notes: VE-SRC-004. The Jockey Club directly describes the Parade Ring/paddock as the pre-race area where horses meet jockeys and parade before racegoers, while distinguishing the pre-parade ring.

working_definition_ja: 主に北米で装鞍や競走前展示を行う区域。

preferred_ja: ウィナーズ・エンクロージャー／表彰区域
working_definition_ja: 競走後に勝馬・上位入着馬や関係者が入り、表彰・記念行事を行う区域。名称や対象馬は競馬場・管轄で異なる。
notes: VE-SRC-005;VE-SRC-006. The Jockey Club describes winning and placed horses entering the Winners’ Enclosure after a race; JRA independently defines ウイナーズ・サークル as its winning-horse presentation area. The Concept preserves facility-name differences.

preferred_ja: グランドスタンド／スタンド
working_definition_ja: 観客席・観覧設備を備えた競馬場の主要な観覧建物。
notes: TR-SRC-001. JRA overseas-racing facility terminology directly maps grandstand to グランドスタンド; facility form and functions vary by racecourse.

working_definition_ja: 競馬場内外で競走馬を収容する区域。
主に北米で馬房を備えた厩舎建物を指す語。
notes: TR-SRC-005. JRA overseas-racing terminology directly maps barn to 厩舎／馬舎 and cross-references stable; retain North American/regional preferred-label scope rather than merging all stable-facility senses.

working_definition_ja: 馬を収容・管理する施設。
競走前後に馬を歩かせる区域。
周回コース一周の公称距離。
notes: P0-SRC-018. JRA course pages publish one-lap course distance for defined track layouts.

working_definition_ja: 走路の横幅。
notes: P1-SRC-004;P1-SRC-005. JRA current course data publishes 幅員 for turf, dirt and/or obstacle layouts; measurement and variation are course-specific.

working_definition_ja: 反時計回りに周回するコース方向。
notes: P0-SRC-018;P0-SRC-019. JRA identifies Tokyo as left-handed and distinguishes left- and right-handed main courses.

working_definition_ja: 時計回りに周回するコース方向。
notes: P0-SRC-019. JRA facility guidance distinguishes right-handed main courses from left-handed courses; generic direction Concept is not jurisdiction-specific.

working_definition_ja: 競走路を時計回り・右回り方向に周回することを示す表現。
notes: TR-SRC-003. JRA overseas-racing terminology directly maps clockwise to 右回り and cross-references right-handed; the label is retained separately from the course-orientation Concept.

working_definition_ja: 主に英国系等で競走路を反時計回り・左回り方向に周回することを示す表現。
notes: TR-SRC-002. JRA overseas-racing terminology directly maps anti-clockwise to 左回り and cross-references left-handed; regional spelling/usage remains explicit.

working_definition_ja: 左回り方向を表す北米系表記。
